notes: «أخبرنا غير، واحد، منهم مغيرة وفلان ورجل ثالث أيضا» is a co-transmitter list with unnamed members (rule 8) and a named one, Mughira. Whether Mughira also stands at the head and again as the last link is not settled, so needs_ruling is set. Mu'awiya writes to Mughira («كتب إلى المغيرة») but only appears in the scene, so he stays out. «وعن هشيم» starts a second route through Abd al-Malik b. Umayr and Warrad (rule 5).
